properties.site-address: Golf Club House, Percy Wood Golf Club and Country Retreat, Swarland
properties.notes: Land currently occupied by a club house and car parking for adjacent golf course. Whilst dependent on the future operation needs of the golf club, it is understood that the site may be available for redevelopment in due course. Clearance of existing buildings would be required. An application for redevelopment of the site for 16 homes is currently pending consideration (19/04108/OUT), This is a revised proposal following the withdrawal of a previous proposal (17/00195/OUT). If permitted, the deliverability of the site will be reappraised.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
